title: Infection of murine vaginal or endocervical mucosa with human papillomavirus pseudovirions
protocol: Shake the Depo-Provera vial well.
Dilute Depo-Provera 1:5 in sterile PBS to a final concentration of 30 mg/ml.
Inject each mouse subcutaneously with 3 mg Depo-Provera in 100 μl.
Shake the diluted Depo-Provera well before drawing up aliquots for injection.
Dissolve powdered CMC in deionized water to prepare a 3% solution.
Prepare a 4% N-9 preparation in 3% CMC.
Skip preparing the 4% N-9 in 3% CMC if using Conceptrol instead.
Dilute pure N-9 to 40% in water before making preparations.
Use positive displacement pipettes for viscous solutions like N-9 and 4% N-9.
Prepare PsV inoculum by diluting purified PsV prep 1:4 in 3% CMC.
Mix 5 μl of PsV prep with 15 μl of 3% CMC to create the inoculum for each mouse (20 μl total).
Make an extra aliquot to account for loss due to sticking to tube walls, etc.
Mix well using positive displacement pipette until schlieren lines disappear.
Place the mouse on its back and secure the tail by taping it to the operating surface.
Deposit 10 μl of inoculum into the mouse vaginal vault using a positive-displacement pipette.
Advance the cytobrush into the vagina until resistance is encountered.
Stabilize the genital tissues by gently grasping the anterior vaginal introitus around the urethral opening with smooth forceps.
Twirl the cytobrush clockwise then counterclockwise 10 times.
Deposit the remaining 10 μl of inoculum into the vaginal vault.
Occlude the introitus by gently grasping the vulva with forceps.
Force the inoculum into the upper portion of the vagina and into the fornices by pushing the forceps cephalad under the pubic arch.
Euthanize mouse by CO2 inhalation on Day 7.
Dissect out the reproductive tract.
Incise the ventral vaginal wall sagitally to open the tubular structure of the vagina so it can be laid flat with the mucosa facing up for whole organ, multispectral imaging.
Place the reproductive tract in PBS on ice for analysis by multispectral imaging.
Acquire and analyze multispectral images.
Fill the vaginal vault with OCT freezing media using a 1000 μl pipette tip.
Place the reproductive tract dorsal side down in the plastic freezing mold and fill the mold bed with OCT for histological analysis.
Snap freeze by placing the bottom side of the mold in contact with the surface of liquid nitrogen, being careful not to submerge the sample.
Cut 5-7 μm sections on a cryotome and collect on slides.
Fix the slide by placing it in 2% paraformaldehyde in PBS for at least 10 minutes.
Mount with DAPI mounting media.
Draw up 50 μl of the N-9 containing material (Conceptrol or 4%N-9 in 3%CMC) into the positive displacement pipette.
Advance the pipette tip into the vaginal vault.
Gently grasp the vulva on either side of the pipette tip with smooth dissecting forceps to force retention of the N-9.
Instill N-9.
Allow 6 hours to elapse.
Draw up 20 μl of the previously prepared PsV inoculum into the positive displacement pipette.
Advance the pipette tip into the vaginal vault.
Gently grasp the vulva on either side of the pipette tip with smooth dissecting forceps to force retention of the PsV inoculum.
Instill the entire 20 μl PsV inoculum.
Repeat steps 11-13 from above.
Make a 1% preparation of CMC by dissolving the powdered form in deionized water.
Make a 4% preparation of N-9 in 1% CMC.
Prepare PsV inoculum by diluting purified PsV prep 1:1 in 1%CMC.
Mix 7 μl of PsV with 7 μl of 1%CMC for each mouse.
For five mice, mix 42 μl of PsV with 42 μl of 1%CMC.
Mix well until schlieren lines disappear using a positive-displacement pipette.
Induce anesthesia in the mouse.
Place the anesthetized mouse on its back and secure the tail to the operating surface.
Load 15 μl of the 4% N-9 in 1% CMC preparation into a gel loading pipette tip.
Position the mouse at a 30° Trendelenburg angle.
Insert closed dissecting forceps into the vagina to gently dilate the introitus.
Remove the forceps and insert a pediatric nasal speculum into the vagina up to the cervix.
Open the speculum to visualize the cervix directly.
Canulate the cervical os with the gel-loading pipette tip.
Advance the pipette tip about 5-10 mm into the cervical canal.
Deposit the N-9 preparation into the cervical canal.
Deposit a 14 μl aliquot of PsV inoculum into the cervical canal.
Follow the steps for histological analysis as described in step #13 under **Vaginal Challenge**.
Take sections from several intervals for accurate identification of the squamocolumnar junction.
